items: Safer links: the app no longer tells other sites which page you came from
A page now warns you if it was opened with someone else's setup link
What's new: this list, under Settings > About
Notes from your trainer show on the home screen, with Got it and Reply; all of them are under Settings > Trainer notes
If your watch sends workout calories on its own, the app no longer asks you to type them
Settings shows an About card: app version, whether the sheet is connected, last load and any problem
Michelle's setup link is gone from Settings now that her iPad is set up
Michelle has her own page and her own data
Tell trainer and Tell developer save your notes for Claude
Exercise list is split into Weights and Core, each with a skip-today switch
Spoken numbers like "thirty six" are heard correctly, even with a pause in the middle
The rep counter ticks at the end of each rep
Levels and XP from sets, push sets, records, quotas and streaks
Trainer voices: an AI coach or Josh's own recordings, picked in Settings
Pace callouts and a two-tone beat during sets; push sets tell you to max it out
Your weight changes on the exercise screen stick for the session, with the PowerBlock setup shown
Form tips rotate during sets and rest
Fewer spoken prompts and a more reliable mic
Body map: mark areas good, sore or hurt, with a check-in every two days
Push set: set 3, or the set that finishes your weekly quota, gets a number to beat
Weeks always run Monday to Sunday
Settings gear with Exercises, Body map, Voice prompts, Choose voice and Reload plan
Buttons answer to their spoken names
Landscape layout and clearer streak tile
